name: siliconflow
description: OpenAI-compatible inference for open models: chat, embeddings, rerank, images, speech and video
long_description: Bring a SiliconFlow API key from cloud.siliconflow.com (the international platform; siliconflow.cn is a separate platform with its own API host and is not covered). The gateway keeps the key off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key reads the account's user info (GET /v1/user/info), which runs no model and costs nothing. A Sprite can then list models and call chat completions (OpenAI- and Anthropic-style), text completions, embeddings, rerank, image generation, text-to-speech, transcription and video generation, all billed to your SiliconFlow balance per model. API key management, billing, reference-voice upload and deletion, and the alpha SystemOne endpoint are not forwarded.

notes: SiliconFlow has no request timeout parameter and Sprites waits 120 seconds for response headers, so set `stream: true` for long answers and reasoning models; streaming sends headers at once. Model ids come from `GET /v1/models`.

messages.403: SiliconFlow refused the request; the model may need real-name verification, see the body's message

presentation.tagline: Run open models on SiliconFlow from a Sprite without putting your SiliconFlow key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at cloud.siliconflow.com, open API Keys (cloud.siliconflow.com/account/ak), click Create API Key and paste it here. This connector calls the international API at api.siliconflow.com; the China platform (siliconflow.cn) has its own API host and is not covered, so use a key created on cloud.siliconflow.com.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /v1/user/info` and runs no model, so it costs nothing. Chat, messages, completions, embeddings and rerank are billed per token; images per image; video per video; speech per UTF-8 byte of input text; transcription per minute of audio; all are charged pay-as-you-go to your SiliconFlow balance at the prices on siliconflow.com/pricing. Listing models, reading user info, listing voices and polling video status run no model.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/user/info`, `GET /v1/models`, `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/messages`, `POST /v1/completions`, `POST /v1/embeddings`, `POST /v1/rerank`, `POST /v1/images/generations`, `POST /v1/audio/speech`, `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`, `GET /v1/audio/voice/list`, `POST /v1/video/submit` and `POST /v1/video/status` are forwarded. `GET /v1/user/info` lets a Sprite read your account id, status and balances. Reference-voice upload and deletion, the alpha SystemOne endpoint, API key management and billing are not forwarded.

usage_notes: SiliconFlow is OpenAI-compatible: point an OpenAI client's base URL at the gateway URL plus `/v1`. `POST /v1/messages` takes Anthropic-style requests.
Rate limits apply per account and per model (RPM and TPM for language models, IPM and IPD for images) and rise with your usage tier.

The Sprites gateway caps direct uploads at 8,000,000 bytes (8 MB); larger request bodies return HTTP 413. This limits audio files sent to `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` and base64 images in chat and video requests.
Error bodies are `{"code": ..., "message": "...", "data": null}`; a wrong key answers 401 with code 30014.
